usedFor: datelist holds the bookings, and HubSpot receives each customer through “Create Contact” from “New Booking Is Made”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Is Made” in datelist, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A booking is where a customer first shows up, so “Create Contact” records them in HubSpot right then.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so check that the booking form collects one.
